title_en: Amendment (VII) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1. Paragraph 3 of Article 151 of the Criminal Law is amended to read: 'Whoever smuggles rare plants and their products or other goods or articles the import or export of which is prohibited by the State shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years and shall also be fined.'

Article 2. Paragraph 1 of Article 180 of the Criminal Law is amended to read: 'Any person who has access to inside information on securities or futures trading or who illegally obtains such inside information, and prior to the disclosure of information that involves the issuance of securities, trading of securities or futures, or other information that has a material impact on the prices of securities or futures, buys or sells the securities, engages in futures trading related to such inside information, or divulges the information, or explicitly or implicitly suggests others to engage in the above trading activities, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined not less than one time but not more than five times the illegal gains; if the circumstances are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined not less than one time but not more than five times the illegal gains.'
A fourth paragraph is added: 'Any employee of a financial institution such as a stock exchange, futures exchange, securities company, futures brokerage company, fund management company, commercial bank, or insurance company, or any staff member of a relevant regulatory authority or industry association, who, in violation of regulations, uses other undisclosed information obtained by virtue of his position, other than inside information, to engage in securities or futures trading activities related to such information, or explicitly or implicitly suggests others to engage in relevant trading activities, if the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph.'

Article 3. Article 201 of the Criminal Law is amended to read: 'Any taxpayer who, by means of deception or concealment, makes a false tax declaration or does not make a tax declaration, and evades the payment of taxes in a relatively large amount and the amount evaded accounts for more than ten percent of the taxes payable, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined; if the amount is huge and accounts for more than thirty percent of the taxes payable, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.
'Any withholding agent who, by the means listed in the preceding paragraph, fails to pay or underpays the taxes withheld or collected, if the amount is relatively large, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
'If the acts described in the preceding two paragraphs have been committed repeatedly without being dealt with, the cumulative amount shall be calculated.
'Where a person who commits the act described in the first paragraph, after the tax authority has issued a notice of recovery according to law, pays the taxes payable and the late payment surcharge, and has already received an administrative penalty, his criminal liability shall not be investigated; except where he has been subject to criminal punishment for tax evasion or has been given two or more administrative penalties by the tax authority within the past five years.'

Article 4. One article is added after Article 224 of the Criminal Law as Article 224a: 'Whoever organizes or leads pyramid selling activities, under the guise of promoting goods or providing services and other business operations, requiring participants to pay fees or purchase goods or services to obtain the qualification for joining, and forming a hierarchy in a certain order, directly or indirectly using the number of persons developed as the basis for calculating remuneration or returning profits, inducing or coercing participants to continue to develop others to join, defrauding property and disrupting the economic and social order, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years and shall also be fined.'

Article 5. Subparagraph (3) of Article 225 of the Criminal Law is amended to read: 'Engaging in securities, futures or insurance business without the approval of the relevant competent department of the State, or illegally engaging in fund payment and settlement business;'

Article 6. Article 239 of the Criminal Law is amended to read: 'Whoever kidnaps another person for the purpose of extorting property or kidnaps another person as a hostage shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have his property confiscated; if the circumstances are relatively minor, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined.
'Whoever commits the crime in the preceding paragraph and causes the death of the kidnapped person or kills the kidnapped person shall be sentenced to death and have his property confiscated.
'Whoever steals an infant or a young child for the purpose of extorting property shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding two paragraphs.'

Article 7. One article is added after Article 253 of the Criminal Law as Article 253a: 'Any staff member of a State organ or a unit such as a financial, telecommunications, transportation, educational, or medical institution, who, in violation of State regulations, sells or illegally provides to others the citizens' personal information obtained by the unit in the course of performing its duties or providing services, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined.
'Whoever steals or illegally obtains the above information by other means, if the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
'Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding two paragraphs, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the respective paragraph.'

Article 8. One article is added after Article 262a of the Criminal Law as Article 262b: 'Whoever organizes minors to engage in activities that violate the administration of public security, such as theft, fraud, robbery, or extortion, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.'

Article 9. Two paragraphs are added to Article 285 of the Criminal Law as the second and third paragraphs: 'Whoever, in violation of State regulations, intrudes into a computer information system other than those specified in the preceding paragraph or uses other technical means to obtain data stored, processed or transmitted in such computer information system, or illegally controls such computer information system, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.
'Whoever provides programs or tools specially used for intruding into or illegally controlling computer information systems, or knowingly provides programs or tools to another person who commits illegal or criminal acts of intruding into or illegally controlling computer information systems, if the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.'

Article 10. A second paragraph is added to Article 312 of the Criminal Law: 'Where a unit commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.'

Article 11. Paragraph 1 of Article 337 of the Criminal Law is amended to read: 'Whoever, in violation of the State regulations on animal and plant epidemic prevention and quarantine, causes a major animal or plant epidemic, or creates a risk of causing a major animal or plant epidemic, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined.'

Article 12. Paragraph 2 of Article 375 of the Criminal Law is amended to read: 'Whoever illegally manufactures or buys or sells uniforms of the armed forces, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined.'
A third paragraph is added: 'Whoever forges, steals, buys or sells, or illegally provides or uses special signs such as vehicle number plates of the armed forces, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.'
The original third paragraph is renumbered as the fourth paragraph and amended to read: 'Where a unit commits the crime in the second or third paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the respective paragraph.'

Article 13. One article is added after Article 388 of the Criminal Law as Article 388a: 'Any close relative of a State functionary or any other person who has a close relationship with the State functionary, through the conduct of the State functionary in his official duties, or by taking advantage of the convenience formed by the powers or position of the State functionary, through the conduct of another State functionary in his official duties, seeks illegitimate benefits for the trustor and demands property from the trustor or accepts property from the trustor, if the amount is relatively large or there are other relatively serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined; if the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years and shall also be fined or have his property confiscated.
'Where a retired State functionary, or a close relative of his, or any other person who has a close relationship with him, commits the act in the preceding paragraph by taking advantage of the convenience formed by the former powers or position of the retired State functionary, he shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.'

Article 14. Paragraph 1 of Article 395 of the Criminal Law is amended to read: 'Where the property or expenditures of a State functionary clearly exceed his lawful income, and the difference is huge, the State functionary may be ordered to explain the source; if the source cannot be explained, the difference shall be regarded as illegal gains, and he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention; if the difference is especially huge, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years. The difference in property shall be recovered.'
Article 15. This Amendment shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
